question: What does the phrasal verb "bring about" mean?
explanation: <Bring about> significa causar que algo suceda, a menudo un cambio o resultado.

question: Choose the correct sentence using "run out of":
options: We ran out time before finishing the project.
We ran out of time before finishing the project.
We ran out on time before finishing the project.
We ran out for time before finishing the project.
correct: We ran out of time before finishing the project.
explanation: <Run out of> significa quedarse sin algo. Siempre lleva <of> antes del sustantivo.

question: Choose the correct meaning of <fall back on>:
options: To return to a previous position
To rely on something as a backup
correct: To rely on something as a backup
explanation: <Fall back on> significa recurrir a algo como último recurso u opción de respaldo.

question: Which phrasal verb means "to delay or postpone"?
explanation: <Put off> significa posponer o aplazar algo para más tarde.

question: What does "take on" mean in a professional context?
options: To accept responsibility or a new challenge
correct: To accept responsibility or a new challenge
explanation: <Take on> significa aceptar una nueva responsabilidad, tarea o empleado.

question: Complete: "She decided to ___ her own business after years of working for others."
explanation: <Set up> significa establecer o iniciar algo, como un negocio u organización.

question: What does "go through" mean when talking about a difficult experience?
explanation: <Go through> significa experimentar algo difícil o desagradable.

question: Which phrasal verb means "to discover information"?
explanation: <Find out> significa descubrir información o averiguar la verdad sobre algo.

question: <back down> — select the right definition:
options: To withdraw from a position or argument
correct: To withdraw from a position or argument
explanation: <Back down> significa dejar de insistir en algo o retirarse de una confrontación.

question: Complete: "The company had to ___ several employees due to budget cuts."
explanation: <Lay off> significa despedir empleados, generalmente por razones financieras. <Lay off> es la forma de pasado simple de <Lie off>.

question: What is the meaning of <keep up with>?
options: To maintain the same pace or level as someone
correct: To maintain the same pace or level as someone
explanation: <Keep up with> significa mantenerse al mismo nivel o ritmo que alguien o algo.

question: Which phrasal verb means "to submit or present formally"?
explanation: <Put forward> significa proponer o presentar formalmente una idea, plan o candidato.

question: Which option describes <wear off>?
options: To gradually disappear or lose effect
correct: To gradually disappear or lose effect
explanation: <Wear off> significa que un efecto o sensación disminuye gradualmente hasta desaparecer.

question: Complete: "He managed to ___ the difficult situation with humour."
explanation: <Get through> significa afrontar con éxito o sobrevivir a una situación difícil.

question: Pick the best definition for <stand out>:
options: To be noticeably different or better
correct: To be noticeably different or better
explanation: <Stand out> significa ser claramente notorio o superior en comparación con los demás.

question: Which phrasal verb means "to tolerate or endure"?
explanation: <Put up with> significa tolerar a alguien o algo desagradable sin quejarse.

question: How would you define <draw on>?
options: To use a resource or experience
correct: To use a resource or experience
explanation: <Draw on> significa hacer uso de una habilidad, experiencia o recurso.

question: Complete: "The new manager ___ a lot of changes in the first month."
explanation: <Bring in> significa introducir algo nuevo, como una política, una norma o una persona. <Brought in> es la forma de pasado simple de <Bring in>.

question: <come across> is closest in meaning to:
options: To find something by chance or make an impression
correct: To find something by chance or make an impression
explanation: <Come across> significa encontrar algo por casualidad, o parecer de cierta manera a los demás.

question: Which phrasal verb means "to investigate something"?
explanation: <Look into> significa investigar o examinar algo cuidadosamente.
